title: Convergence of the tug-of-war scheme for the normalized p-Laplacian
abstract:
A Lean 4 formalization, on top of Mathlib, of the convergence of
p-harmonious functions, the solutions of the dynamic programming principle
of tug-of-war with noise, to the viscosity solution of the Dirichlet problem
for the normalized p-Laplacian, 2 <= p < infinity, as the step size tends to
zero, on bounded open sets satisfying the exterior sphere condition with
continuous bounded boundary data. The compared theorem gives, for every step
size, a p-harmonious function with the given data, uniformly bounded, whose
half-relaxed limits agree on the closure of the domain, equal the data on
its boundary, and are the uniform limit of the family. The development also
proves the asymptotic expansion of the scheme, the viscosity property of the
half-relaxed limits, existence and uniqueness for the discrete problem, the
comparison principle and uniqueness for the limit equation, Aleksandrov's
theorem and Jensen's lemma.
